SESSION 13 WHY AND HOW SHOULD I TELL OTHERS?  
2. PERSUASION (Matthew 5:13–16) 
 
“Since ... we know what it is to fear the Lord, we try to persuade others.” (2 Corinthians 
5:11) 
 
• Work out the answers to common questions. 
– For example: “What about other religions?” and “How can a God of love allow 
suffering?” 
 
• Do it with gentleness and respect. (1 Peter 3:15) 
 
 
 
3. PROCLAMATION (John 1:39–46) 
 
• We are not all called to be “evangelists” but we are all called to be “witnesses.” (v.41) 
• We can all say, “Come and see.” 
 
 
 
4. POWER (1 Thessalonians 1:5) 
 
• The love of God poured into our hearts by the Holy Spirit. 
• Healing 
 
 
 
5. PRAYER (1 Thessalonians 1:5) 
•  
• For others 
• For ourselves—to have boldness (Acts 4:29–31) 
 
Don’t give up—whenever you pass on the good news of Jesus, it has an effect. The gospel 
is the power of God. (Mark 4:15–20)
